description: Source code for Discord message sending, including text, media, webhooks, stickers, polls, and voice messages, with integrations to Discord API and media processing.

methods.name: sendDiscordThreadTextChunks
methods.description: Sends multiple text chunks to a Discord thread, handling message chunking.

methods.name: deriveForumThreadName
methods.description: Derives a thread name from the first non-empty line of message text.

methods.name: isForumLikeType
methods.description: Checks if a channel type is a forum or media channel.

methods.name: toDiscordSendResult
methods.description: Converts Discord message result to a standardized send result.

methods.name: resolveDiscordSendTarget
methods.description: Resolves the target Discord channel and client request objects.

methods.name: sendMessageDiscord
methods.description: Sends a message (text, media, or thread) to a Discord channel or thread.

methods.name: resolveWebhookExecutionUrl
methods.description: Constructs the URL for executing a Discord webhook.

methods.name: sendWebhookMessageDiscord
methods.description: Sends a message via Discord webhook.

methods.name: sendStickerDiscord
methods.description: Sends stickers to a Discord channel or recipient.

methods.name: sendPollDiscord
methods.description: Sends a poll to a Discord channel or recipient.

methods.name: materializeVoiceMessageInput
methods.description: Downloads and prepares a media URL for voice message, converting to OGG/Opus if needed.

methods.name: sendVoiceMessageDiscord
methods.description: Sends a voice message (audio) to a Discord recipient or channel, handling media conversion and metadata.
